A second half to the exercise above: this one is a **stub**, so its reference is a citation the protocol will also notify the other side about.

![[205h9zh1rz157pnxqqwkzxacby]]

The point of the pairing: a stub's `stub_of` and a remote transclusion now both carry `cited`, and the Webmention this publish sends is verified against the bare reference alone — origin and id — with the citation ignored entirely. A label a receiver could be persuaded by would be a label worth forging.
